title: Random Items plugin
description: It gives random items to all players on the server after the specified time has elapsed (the time can be specified in the configuration) this plugin can be useful for mini-games or experimental servers.
body: It gives random items to all players on the server after the specified time has elapsed (the time can be specified in the configuration) this plugin can be useful for mini-games or experimental servers.      How it works in the Pillars mini-game: Players run across pillars trying to knock each other down. But now every 10-15 seconds (configurable in the config) all players are given random items directly into the inventory. It can be anything from ordinary snowballs to fireballs, an elitra or a diamond sword! Why it changes everything: No more boredom — every round is unique because loot is constantly changing Snowballs against swords — imagine a player with a sword trying to run up to someone who throws snowballs with a bouncing Monster on pillars — yes, now you can plan between pillars! Fireballs = chaos — explosions knock down everyone around and ruin strategies, no one knows what will happen in a minute — adaptation becomes a key skill
